newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS - Philips dominates EOE after results.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Philips dominates EOE after results.

text.p: Philips options again made up most of the trade on the European Options Exchange on Thursday after the company reported sharply lower third quarter net profits.

Turnover in Philips options swamped all others, comprising 34 percent of the total volume. Puts outweighed calls by 20,000 to 8,000 as investors reacted to results that dealers termed very disappointing.
Philips net profits collapsed by 77 percent to 123 million guilders and the company announced a massive one billion guilder restructuring charge in the fourth quarter.
Index options were relegated to the second string, the EOE contract forming 17 percent of the turnover. Puts led calls by around 9,000 to 5,000.
